name: Munching Squares
desc: The classic PDP-1 munching squares reborn in color: (x XOR y) bit-patterns cascade as nested squares that interleave, pulse and munch through a vivid cyclic palette, morphing between XOR, AND and multiplicative moire across sections — pure bit-pattern hypnosis rendered as rainbow interference, green phosphor CRT, amber terminal, thermal false-color, or a hard black-and-white bit-field.

density.doc: grid cell count — higher = finer nested squares / more detail

scale.doc: feature zoom — bigger squares when higher

bands.doc: color cycles across the bit-value range (moire density)

x.doc: pattern origin x (pans the nesting center)
